vendors.summary: The network-as-product vendor: ~5,000 agencies searching each other's cameras, plus drones, audio sensors, and a people-lookup layer. 50+ US cities have cancelled since 2025.

platform.name: FlockOS + TALON

features.d: Enter a plate; the system finds vehicles that frequently travel with it — flagged as potential associates even if they only share a commute.

A person-lookup layer that "jumps from LPR to person" using data-broker records — reported to have drawn on breached datasets.
Aerodome drones launch automatically to camera hits.
Every search logs a typed reason — the mechanism that exposed the Texas abortion search and a police chief's stalking. Also the mechanism where "hehehe" passed as a search reason.

platform.onRecord: Grand Prairie, TX police ran a slur through Convoy Analysis six times — targeting a traveling community with no crime specified (EFF, from audit logs).
